blocks.text: The LIKE and VISIT codes open when the game reaches a goal of likes or visits, then stay valid for a set time (14 days for LIKE1 , 7 days for the VISIT codes). The codes window of the game shows the next goals and how close the game is. When a new code opens, it is posted in the news and on this page.
